body.name: Global admissible signal-and-error parameter space
body.construction: \(\Theta_n=\{\theta=(A,a_0,d,\Sigma,\mathsf Q_{\varepsilon}):\operatorname{rank}(A)=r,\ c_{\mathrm{lo}}\le\sigma_r(A)\le\sigma_1(A)\le C_{\mathrm{hi}},\ \lambda_{\min}(\Sigma)\ge c_{\mathrm{lo}},\ \lambda_{\max}(\Sigma)\le C_{\mathrm{hi}},\text{ there exist bounded }(F_{\mathrm{pre}},U_D,\mu_0,f_{\mathrm{post}})\text{ satisfying }A=F_{\mathrm{pre}}U_D,\ a_0=F_{\mathrm{pre}}\mu_0,\ d^{\prime}=f_{\mathrm{post}}^{\prime}U_D,\text{ and }\theta\text{ satisfies every condition indexed in }\texttt{by-member-properties}\}\), at triangular-array index \(n\). The rank equality forces \(F_{\mathrm{pre}}\) and \(U_D\) to have rank \(r\), so \(a_0\in\operatorname{col}(A)\) and \(d\in\operatorname{row}(A)\) are consequences rather than separate restrictions. The error-law coordinate \(\mathsf Q_{\varepsilon}\) carries the stationary dependence, tail, mixing, and long-run covariance features; \(J,K,L,r,\{n_\ell\},T_1,S,\rho,c_{\mathrm{lo}},C_{\mathrm{hi}}\) are fixed design coordinates governed by the same listed properties.
